purpose: A per-unit catalogue for future JGA service/sales resource costing; no actual workload, demand, commercial offer or new signed-project obligation.

families.label: Actual sales attempts and proposals, including unsold work
Won-customer setup and additional use preparation
Billing, receipt and actual renewal administration

effort_cases.low: Less complex, largely reusable task within the named unit.
effort_cases.working: Middle analyst planning allowance for this task/unit.
effort_cases.high: More complex within the defined unit; not a cap, forecast, confidence bound or promised service.

hours_status: Untimed analyst planning assumptions only; no timesheet, supplier capacity, observed conversion or empirical validation.

unit_schema.workload_id: Stable proposed WS01–WS21 identifier; not an existing canonical input ID.
unit_schema.family_id: One of nine comparison families; families are not interchangeable quantity drivers.
unit_schema.unit_key: Exact count driver; rows sharing a key must use the same count, except genuinely different scoped selection/reuse adjustments documented against the row.
unit_schema.planning_hours_per_unit: Total human person-hours for one stated unit at low/working/high effort; not hours per every listed role.
unit_schema.unit_quantity: Null until a deliberate scenario quantity is chosen; null is not zero.
unit_schema.shared_work_adjustment: Null until exact reusable work/allocation is evidenced. If used, store asset/version/task, gross hours, actual necessary delta and allocation once.
unit_schema.role_split: Null until actual performer/reviewer split is known. Sum allocated hours to total task hours; never apply full total to each role.
unit_schema.rate_and_cash_basis: Unchosen; no wages or new cash implied by person-hours.
unit_schema.selected_scope: Null until actual service/unit is selected. A deliberate zero or unselected task must have a basis, not silently fill a critical unknown.

tasks.task: Reusable commercial pack and campaign readiness
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One explicitly defined selling campaign using a named edition/offer. Confirm actual offered outputs, fulfilment boundaries, commercial description and reusable proposal/entitlement templates.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: Do not recreate or reprice the complete report, its commercial preview, or initial report use-option analysis already in WR09/WR16. A second campaign reuses the asset and costs only real updating work.

tasks.task: Campaign administration, pipeline review and close
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One campaign's common scheduling, pipeline status reconciliation, aggregate review and close/archive. Covers common work; individual case activity is in WS03–WS07.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: No automatic monthly sales team, retainer, CRM purchase or annual campaign count. Distinguish common review from the same customer contact/proposal work.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One actual individually handled approach or short follow-up attempt, including no response, decline or failed contact. Record each genuinely separate attempt; a bulk action is not many individually worked attempts.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: Excludes substantive meeting work in WS04 and preparation/negotiation already in WS05/WS06. Not a lead quota, permission to contact or inferred conversion funnel.

tasks.task: Substantive sales discussion and immediate record
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One actual substantive commercial needs/fit discussion: relevant preparation, discussion and immediate note. Includes discussions that do not lead to a proposal or sale.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: T03 exploratory research is excluded. A no-show records only genuinely incurred preparation/handling, not an invented completed meeting; any real extra effort is retained in the same task record.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One actual initial written scoped commercial proposal for a named prospect/order, whether won, lost, declined or unanswered. Define edition/use, bundle entitlements, service preparation, price/terms to be agreed and delivery capability.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: One partner proposal is one attempt, not a separate licence proposal plus briefing proposal for the same combined offer. This is proposal preparation, not new research or current Table feasibility.

tasks.task: Additional material proposal or negotiation round
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One genuinely additional material negotiation/revision round beyond the initial scoped proposal work, including a failed negotiation. An ordinary document save or unchanged resend is not a round.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: If a complete fresh proposal is counted in WS05, do not also count that same writing in WS06. Record preparation, call and revision within one round once.

tasks.task: Won order / agreement and entitlement setup
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One actually agreed customer order or partner bundle: execute/capture agreed terms, record edition/version, recipient/use/service entitlements, delivery route and responsible owner.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: Count the agreement once even if it includes a licence and briefing. Negotiation incurred before a lost order belongs in WS05/WS06. A signature/order record is not receipt of cash or completed fulfilment.

tasks.task: Customer-specific reading path through existing research
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One genuinely requested/scoped task-based route through the already completed full edition and existing tools. Count only actual additional preparation for this user/use.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: The full free research benefit remains intact. Generic summary/preview and existing reading-path assets are reused; do not re-charge WR09/WR16 or repeat the same path because a bundle has several labels. Fresh evidence collection is outside this task.

tasks.task: Scoped client/public-use asset preparation and context check
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One defined asset package for an actually agreed client/public use: exact original material/version, relevant contextual/source checks, attribution and necessary adaptation/layout.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: Use the existing rights review and original design from WR10/WR12. Charge only the additional permitted adaptation/check; no default third-party chart/identity/quote rights, blanket sublicence or new evidence. Multiple genuinely different agreed packages can require repeated work.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One won partner bundle: accurately describe the funded work, agree/capture recognition and logo permissions where relevant, and record the specific benefits and delivery owner.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: If research is already commissioned/complete, do not describe it as a new commission. This task excludes the licence/briefing work counted in WS07–WS09/WS12–WS15. No contact access, seats, exclusivity, favourable conclusions or recurring reporting is presumed.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One won bundle's actual explicitly agreed benefit tracking, progress/closing checks and completion record. The allowance is total person-time for the bundle's chosen scope, not one imposed checkpoint. If repeated checks are agreed, sum their genuine work and override the allowance.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: No default monthly report or newly compulsory partner service. Reuse invoice, delivery and briefing records; do not redo the underlying work. Multiple real checks can create legitimate additional hours within the same bundle; do not remove them merely because the bundle is counted once.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One actual prepared distribution run/batch using the named full edition and agreed route: recipient/access list handling, send/access action and basic delivery reconciliation. Paid, bundled and free practitioner copies can share the same run.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: A common batch is counted once; no second free-copy charge for the same send. An additional recipient-specific delivery action or separate run is incremental real work, not a second research-production cost. Effort depends on recipient/route complexity; override the hours when material.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One actual agreed session, including a partner-bundled session: confirm audience/use/agenda, arrange it and prepare supported existing findings/material. Planning hours are total preparer/coordinator person-hours.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: No new research, unlimited inquiry or promised turnaround. Reuse a prepared briefing and count only the necessary preparation delta for a repeat audience/session. Where WS08 reading-path work is reused, credit only that exact saved task and allocate common person-time once. If an unchanged reusable preparation package supports several sessions, assign it once rather than duplicating full preparation. One joint session serving several entitled customers/partners is one session, not one per attendee or bundle.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One delivered session, whether standalone or included in a partner/customer bundle. The illustrative effort cases assume 0.5/1/1.5 total presenter person-hours; actual duration × actual delivery headcount replaces that assumption when scoped.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: Duration/headcount are planning choices, not promised session lengths or staffing. A second necessary presenter is real additional person-time; do not multiply the same full task hours by every role. A repeat session is a real repeat unit even if preparation is reused.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One session's agreed bounded follow-up: route the agreed materials, clarify supported points and capture completion/open questions within the chosen scope.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: No general analyst inquiry desk, compliance advice, bespoke consulting, new study or recurring support is assumed. If one shared follow-up is reused for multiple sessions, allocate the common work once; genuinely different follow-up remains incremental.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One actual access/use/service issue: receive, identify affected edition/entitlement, distinguish an ordinary correction from a new request, assign the appropriate owner and record status. Count the issue once, not every reply.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: WS18 contains resolution and closing work for this same case; do not include it here. Paid, bundled and free recipients can create cases. No new support entitlement or participant form is created; fresh research/advice is outside the scope.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One actual invoice/collection cycle: create/check invoice, routine agreed follow-up, reconcile receipt and link it to the order and fulfilment record. Count additional genuinely separate staged invoices as separate cycles only for their incremental work.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: Invoice, cash receipt and delivery remain different statuses. Do not count invoice value and receipt as two revenues. Costs already included in supplier/package/admin fees are reconciled once. No tax/recovery/payment-platform rule is presumed.

tasks.task: Service-case resolution, correction routing and close
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One triaged case's reasonable existing-material response, access/entitlement fix, correction routing, necessary replacement delivery and closing record. Same case count as WS16; its distinct resolution person-time is recorded here. Additional real handling changes the hours, not the count of the same case.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: New source/content correction, narrative revision, QA and ordinary contractual remedy stay in WR10/WR13/WR14 or the appropriate production route; this row contains only incremental customer resolution/routing/redistribution and does not create an extra fee. If several cases share a correction notice/replacement send, prepare/send it once and allocate that common work once; do not also count the same send in WS12. A separately requested new study or advisory service is not included.

tasks.task: Actually initiated renewal or expiry administration
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One actual renewal/expiry case if a defined term or genuinely wanted next edition makes it relevant, including a renewal that does not proceed. Confirm version/entitlements/status and close or route the case.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: No auto-renewal, subscription, annual update, future council tenure or new edition is assumed. New prospecting/proposal/research work belongs in the relevant task once; do not add a full second sales cycle here by default.

tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One separately chosen short note drawing on existing permitted material: useful takeaways, evidence limits, unresolved questions and indirect-identification review. One shared note can serve all permitted recipients.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: This T02 benefit idea is uncommitted. No promised answer to every practitioner question, monthly note, advice desk, new research or event production. Distribution uses WS12 once; the same note is not produced separately for each partner/free recipient.

tasks.task: Campaign fulfilment readiness and distribution-route setup
tasks.unit_definition_and_counting_rule: One campaign's additional customer-facing fulfilment-readiness check for its named edition/offer: confirm usable master/notice, agreed delivery/access route, recipient/entitlement handling and a practical send/check procedure. WS01 covers commercial offer assets; this row covers only delivery operation.
tasks.boundary_and_exclusions: WR14 already covers final report QA and portable JGA handover; do not repeat it. Reuse an existing tested release/route and count only the genuinely necessary readiness check/update. If multiple campaigns share an unchanged configuration, allocate its setup once and retain only actual incremental checks. No new website, platform purchase or access restriction is required.

counting_invariants: A partner bundle is one commercial order, with explicit entitlements. Do not add its licence again to unbundled licence revenue/units; prepare/deliver its included briefing once under the total session count.

briefing_session_count includes all actually scoped/delivered sessions, both bundled and standalone, rather than only unbundled paid briefings. Record cancellation/preparation work actually incurred separately against the relevant task, without inventing a live delivery.
Sales units include lost, declined, unanswered and abandoned attempts where actual work occurred. Do not derive attempt quantities from won counts using an unmeasured conversion rate.

Count common campaign work once for a shared campaign. One actual prospect may legitimately incur contacts, discussion, proposal and negotiation work; these are different tasks, not duplicate full sales costs.

An additional discussion, proposal, delivery run, checkpoint or briefing may be legitimate repeated effort. Match actual output/date/scope and remove the same person-time, not all repeated units by name.

Free full research is preserved. Deliveries to paid, bundled and practitioner recipients can share a common run; charge shared preparation/send once and only genuine incremental extra runs/interventions. Copy count is not a research-production multiplier.

WR14 covers report final QA and portable JGA handover, not automatic future dispatch to every free or paid customer. Include customer distribution effort where genuinely required; do not charge another full handover for the same work.
Initial report research, all 21 existing WR/JG tasks, T03 exploratory research and event production remain in their correct components. This catalogue cannot remove or replace them.

Report production occurs per actual edition, not per customer or partner bundle. A requested new study or substantive new evidence edition must be separately defined and referred to the research component.
No quantity, calendar cadence, buyer/member quota, demand, conversion, fee, contact permission, supplier capacity, hire or new recurring obligation is established by this catalogue.
costing_rules: Compute a unit task resource value only when a selected hours case/override and an appropriate selected rate or reconciled package allocation are available. Missing rates remain unavailable rather than zero.

Quantity × selected total person-hours per unit gives programme task hours only when a deliberate quantity is present. Programme total remains unavailable while applicable required quantities/rates are missing.
An explicitly selected zero quantity with a recorded reason can deactivate a task; a blank quantity or blank applicable cost is unknown.
Keep full resource valuation separate from additional cash. Already budgeted JGA salary/opportunity time does not automatically create extra payroll expenditure.
Choose/reconcile an actual supplier package or scoped task rates. Do not add the same package labour and bottom-up work or overhead twice.
Use exact recorded reuse credits once; a generic AI saving percentage or existing free article is not a verified reduction.
Amounts, taxes, supplier minimums, expenses, currency conversion and cash dates are intentionally outside this workload-only candidate file.

This catalogue does not produce numerical customer-acquisition cost (CAC), a conversion rate, sales forecast or margin. Any later measure requires actual appropriate cost scope, period and genuinely acquired-customer counts, separately evidenced.
confidence: Low as a workload prediction. Useful unit definitions and sensitivity suggestions only; validate scope, actual effort, staffing/capacity, reuse and cash basis before selecting a programme budget.
